email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoInsulex patient with mild nausea
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am an a member of staff at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 81-year-old male patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their third dose of DemoInsulex (dose: 5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-07.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

[Message forwarded from a shared inbox; original sender identity was not preserved.]
